correctness.rationale: For the precisely defined cubic circulant graph, two independent face tests agree on every one of 16383 candidate nonempty subsets; exactly 2046 are faces. The deterministic full-poset matching has 1021 pairs, critical masks 128, 3141, 4373, 9556, and the entire 8946-incidence oriented Hasse graph topologically sorts. An exact signed Morse recursion yields the integral 5-to-4 boundary column (-1,-1), a primitive vector, so by pi_4(S4 wedge S4)=Z^2 the CW model is homotopy equivalent to S4. Independently computed mod-two boundary ranks 13,78,244,400,257,30 corroborate the result. All 149 facets have dimensions 5 or 6, giving nonpure non-shellability by the verified H4 and Björner-Wachs Theorem 4.1. Complete standalone checker and actual output are supplied.

value.rationale: The canonical 14-vertex Möbius ladder is a highly symmetric cubic circulant graph; its first higher-independence (P3-devoid) topology is a natural object missing from established ordinary-independence/forest/cycle classifications. An exact primitive, nonzero Morse attaching map distinguishes homotopy from simple critical-cell counts, and the resulting four-dimensional integral class below every facet dimension yields a substantive nonpure non-shellability theorem. The exact graph, invariant, and structural obstruction are motivated independently of the computation and serve as a reproducible reference for further higher-independence studies.
